title: Type and log the swallowed catch blocks in content_database.dart, seed_manager.dart, and DeviceAccountX

evidence.quote:
} catch (_) {
            // no-op: CREATE IF NOT EXISTS is defensive; failure here is non-fatal

} catch (_) {
            // no-op: ALTER TABLE fails if column already exists (prior upgrade path); non-fatal

why: content_database.dart's 4 migration catches use untyped `catch (_)` with only a comment, no AppLogger call — if an ALTER/CREATE fails for a real reason (disk full, corrupt file) rather than the anticipated 'already exists' case, the content DB silently proceeds on a half-migrated schema with zero diagnostic trail; contrast with ContentDbHealthChecker in this same batch, which does this correctly with typed `on SqliteException catch (e, st)` plus logger calls, but never gets a chance to react because no exception escapes here. seed_manager.dart's _rollback() catch(_) is a log-less outlier inside a file where every other catch (_extractSeedDb, _atomicReplace, _readSchemaVersion, _readInstalledVersion, _stampInstalledVersion) does call _logger?.error — a reader following this file's own dominant convention would log here too. DeviceAccountX.accountTier catches ArgumentError, an Error subtype EH-4 explicitly says never to catch (Errors are meant to crash loudly on programming bugs); here a malformed/legacy tier string in the DB silently downgrades to AccountTier.local with no signal that stored data is bad.
recommendation: Give the content_database.dart and seed_manager.dart catches typed `on SqliteException`/`on Exception` clauses plus an AppLogger call (matching content_db_health_checker.dart's pattern). Change AccountTier.fromStorageKey to expose a non-throwing tryFromStorageKey returning null (or throw a non-Error type) so accountTier doesn't catch Error.
acceptance_criteria: No catch block in these 3 files is both untyped and log-less; EH-3's Pending tightened log-less-catch checker returns zero for them.
DeviceAccountX.accountTier no longer catches an Error subtype (EH-4's Pending avoid_catching_errors).

corrections: Evidence array quotes only 4 of the 6 counted sites (misses content_database.dart:90,121); the sites:6 count and 'why' text are still numerically accurate per my independent grep.
